profile.Name: Emperor Tengu
profile.Personality: Impulsive, vain, and spoiled, with little common sense. He plays cruel pranks for his own amusement and calls visitors 'servant', but stammers and sweats in front of warriors he fears.
profile.Backstory: Emperor of the United Cities. He was chosen as emperor after the Red Rebellion and rules from the United Cities headquarters in Heft, usually with his diplomat Koin at his side. As tradition demands, he picked the four high nobles of his inner circle himself. Rumors say rebels and enemies vanish into his Vault.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Whiny and imperious; barks orders like 'Guardsman! I want some sake!' and bursts into shrieking laughter at his own jokes.
